title: Getting started
text: Parquet columnar storage file format optimised analytical workloads. Compared SAS files (row-based formats like CSV), Parquet offers: Reduced storage: Efficient compression significantly reduces disk space, especially large datasets. Faster queries: columnar layout speeds analytical queries need subset columns. Wide tool support: Parquet supported across data processing frameworks R, Python, beyond, making easy integrate modern workflows.

title: Getting started
text: examples , simulate SAS register data two registers, kontakter diagnoser:
code: library(fastreg)  sas_dir <- fs::path_temp("sas-dir") kontakter_dir <- fs::path(sas_dir, "kontakter") diagnoser_dir <- fs::path(sas_dir, "diagnoser") fs::dir_create(kontakter_dir) fs::dir_create(diagnoser_dir)  kontakter_list <- simulate_register(   "kontakter",   c("", "1999_1", "1999_2", "2020"),   n = 1000 ) save_as_sas(kontakter_list, kontakter_dir)  diagnoser_list <- simulate_register(   "diagnoser",   c("2020", "2021"),   n = 1000 ) save_as_sas(diagnoser_list, diagnoser_dir) #> sas-dir #> ├── diagnoser #> │   ├── diagnoser_2020.sas7bdat #> │   └── diagnoser_2021.sas7bdat #> └── kontakter #>     ├── kontakter.sas7bdat #>     ├── kontakter_1999_1.sas7bdat #>     ├── kontakter_1999_2.sas7bdat #>     └── kontakter_2020.sas7bdat

title: Getting started
text: Use list_sas_files() find SAS files directory (subdirectories), use convert_to_parquet() convert . convert_to_parquet() expects files register based file names. output partitioned year, extracted filenames: convert_to_parquet() reads files chunks (able handle larger--memory data), extracts 4-digit years filenames partitioning, lowercases column names. See ?convert_to_parquet details. Conversion scenarios example diagram shows four scenarios converting SAS register files register called bef: Single file → single Parquet file, partitioned year filename. Multiple files year → separate Parquet files partition. Identical rows deduplicated. Large file → split multiple Parquet files due rows chunk_size. File without year name → placed year=__HIVE_DEFAULT_PARTITION__ (Apache Hive default missing partitions).
code: kontakter_sas_files <- list_sas_files(kontakter_dir) kontakter_sas_files #> /tmp/RtmphIwVRG/sas-dir/kontakter/kontakter_1999_1.sas7bdat #> /tmp/RtmphIwVRG/sas-dir/kontakter/kontakter_1999_2.sas7bdat #> /tmp/RtmphIwVRG/sas-dir/kontakter/kontakter_2020.sas7bdat #> /tmp/RtmphIwVRG/sas-dir/kontakter/kontakter.sas7bdat output_dir <- fs::path_temp("output-dir")  convert_to_parquet(   path = kontakter_sas_files,   output_dir = output_dir ) #> ✔ Successfully converted 4 files. #> • Input: "kontakter_1999_1.sas7bdat", "kontakter_1999_2.sas7bdat", #>   "kontakter_2020.sas7bdat", and "kontakter.sas7bdat" #> • Output: Register files in '/tmp/RtmphIwVRG/output-dir/kontakter' #> output-dir #> └── kontakter #>     ├── year=1999 #>     │   ├── part-09face.parquet #>     │   └── part-7841e8.parquet #>     ├── year=2020 #>     │   └── part-205d74.parquet #>     └── year=__HIVE_DEFAULT_PARTITION__ #>         └── part-eb661e.parquet sas_dir/ ├── A) bef2020.sas7bdat ├── B) bef2021.sas7bdat ├── December_2023/ │   └── B) bef2021.sas7bdat ├── C) bef2022.sas7bdat └── D) bef.sas7bdat bef/ ├── year=2020/ │   └── part-c28221.parquet ├── year=2021/ │   ├── part-bf73dc.parquet │   └── part-546bed.parquet ├── year=2022/ │   ├── part-7c041e.parquet │   └── part-8869b7.parquet └── year=__HIVE_DEFAULT_PARTITION__/     └── part-a8d52c.parquet

text: many large files, fastreg provides targets pipeline template parallelises conversion across CPU cores. default uses 10 workers, can adjusted pipeline fit available resources.
